topics.title: The Simple Past Tense (Le Passé Simple)
topics.objective: Master the formation, recognition, and literary deployment of the *passé simple* tense in historical narratives, literature, and formal texts.

topics.title: The Past Anterior Tense (Le Passé Antérieur)
topics.objective: Form and correctly utilize the *passé antérieur* to express a completed action that occurred immediately prior to another action expressed in the *passé simple*.

topics.title: Advanced Historical & Narrative Syntax (Passé Simple vs Imparfait vs Passé Antérieur)
topics.objective: Master the complex interaction of literary past tenses (*passé simple*, *imparfait*, *passé antérieur*, *plus-que-parfait*) to structure multi-layered historical narratives.
